title: On the Exact Linearization of Multi-Input Discrete-Time Flat Systems
summary: In this contribution, we address the exact linearization of forward- and backward-flat discrete-time nonlinear systems with an arbitrary number of inputs. Building on structural properties of the flat parameterization, we show that forward-flat systems can be rendered static feedback linearizable by prolongations of suitably transformed inputs. Analogously, for backward-flat systems, we derive a constructive procedure showing that an exact linearization can be achieved by prelongations of suitably chosen functions of the system variables.
